metadata.title: Pork with Mung beans | Northeastern Style
metadata.description:
This pork with Mung beans recipe is a classic Northeastern recipe. It's  is very simple to prepare as it takes very few ingredients to make, however this dish tastes delicious with the basic ingredients. 

The succulent pork meat and soft boiled mung beans compliment each other to bring out the best of the flavors. 
You can serve this dish with steamed rice or as an individual dish.
